notes_for_editor: Story is about 60 words, below the 120-word guide floor, because no register, agency, news or heritage record was found after two web searches and a check of the Mississippi archive series page. Only OpenStreetMap and its Mapcarta mirror support the tower. The OSM name says Lookout but the tag is observation, so fire-lookout identity is unconfirmed. Record location (32.447643, -90.746491) not checked against a second source. OSM gives ele 104 m; not used because it does not appear in the fetched text. Editor should decide whether to keep this as a stub.
